headerDisplay: [homebridge-intesisweb](https://github.com/jhschuster/homebridge-intesisweb) connects Intesis AC Cloud Control mini-splits to HomeKit.
footerDisplay: For setup, behavior, and troubleshooting details, see the [README](https://github.com/jhschuster/homebridge-intesisweb#readme).

username.title: Intesis User Name
username.description: Username used to sign in to AC Cloud Control

password.title: Intesis Password
password.description: Password used to sign in to AC Cloud Control

swingMode.title: Swing Mode
swingMode.description: Should swing mode affect the horizontal or vertical vanes? Defaults to horizontal.

configCacheSeconds.title: Cache Time
configCacheSeconds.description: Seconds between AC Cloud status polls

defaultTemperature.title: Default Temperature
defaultTemperature.description: Temperature (in Celsius) to use when telemetry is unavailable. 0 falls back to the current setpoint, then 20 °C if needed.

form.title: Advanced Settings (Optional)
form.description: These are optional settings that you can adjust if needed. The defaults should work for nearly everyone.
